user_prompt: Use $modal-sandbox to benchmark two equivalent approaches under the same sandbox controls.

recovery_guidance.remote_nonzero: Retain partial runs and compare only successful equivalent repetitions.
recovery_guidance.timeout: Report timed-out scenarios separately from completed measurements.
recovery_guidance.truncated_output: Use output hashes for comparison and disclose truncated previews.
recovery_guidance.cleanup_failure: Report the failed scenario cleanup and do not hide partial results.

plugin_plan.resource_boundary: Live benchmark runs and destructive cleanup require explicit user approval.
